name: Last Scene ~Boku ga Kimi ni Dekiru Koto~
original_name: Last Scene ～僕が君にできること～
source:
Our guy became a doctor in order to try to find a cure for his girlfriend's disease. Now that he is a doctor, he found out that she only has seven days to live. Will he try to find a cure with some nurses' help, spend time with her at a seaside hotel, or resort to drastic measures?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们的家伙成为一名医生是为了尝试找到治疗他女朋友疾病的方法。如今他成为了一名医生，却发现她的生命只剩下七天了。他会在护士的帮助下尝试找到治疗方法，在海边酒店与她共度时光，还是采取严厉措施？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李家欢乐屋[/url]]
